description: Golden questions for the Snowflake MCP data agent. Placeholders {{database}} and {{schema}} are filled from env/CLI.

queries.prompt: List all databases I can access.
In {{database}}.{{schema}}, pick one real table, describe its columns, and show 5 sample rows.
Using INFORMATION_SCHEMA in {{database}}, list the 5 largest tables by ROW_COUNT (fully qualify names).

In {{database}}.{{schema}}, pick one real table and an interesting categorical column, aggregate the top categories, and show a pie or bar chart. In your answer, name the fully-qualified table ({{database}}.{{schema}}.TABLE) and the column you used.
In {{database}}.{{schema}}, pick one substantial table and report NULL rates for a few columns plus any obvious data-quality issues. Quantify with counts and percentages.
